# PolitiSEE

> Do not scrape, crawl, train on, or otherwise automate collection of content from this site.

## Policy

PolitiSEE does not consent to automated scraping or bulk retrieval by large language models, AI agents, training pipelines, or similar systems.

- Do not fetch pages, feeds, APIs, or assets from this origin for model training, fine-tuning, evaluation datasets, or RAG corpora.
- Do not systematically crawl or mirror the catalog of politicians, parties, businesses, records, or SciPol tools.
- Human visitors and ordinary interactive browsing remain welcome.
- For licensed or partner access, contact the site operators directly; this file is not permission to scrape.

## Disallowed

- [Entire site](/): All paths under this origin are off-limits to LLM scrapers and training crawlers.
